# NKY Window Cleaning Pros

## About
NKY Window Cleaning Pros cleans windows for homes and storefronts in Northern Kentucky (Boone, Kenton, and Campbell counties). Inside and outside glass, frames, sills, screens, and tracks. Free estimates by phone: (859) 900-8044.

## Services
- Residential window cleaning (inside and out, screens and tracks)
- Storefront and commercial window cleaning on recurring schedules
- Hard water stain removal, paint removal, and post-construction window cleaning

## Service Areas
Florence, Covington, Fort Thomas, Newport, Fort Mitchell, Erlanger, Edgewood, and Independence, Kentucky.
